title: Tina W NDE 8608
content: It happened one night while I was 12 years old. My hands were still wet after I washed them. I turned off the light by pressing the button of the table lamp. Immediately, I got electrocuted. The electricity pulled the into my hand. My whole body started convulsing as I was screaming. At this time, I felt my legs leaving my body. I was floating up in mid-air and was suspended over my head. Then I saw a light that was brighter than the sunlight as it encompassed me. I could stared at it directly without hurting my eyes. Yet as comparing with my twitched body underneath, I felt extremely calm. Slowly, I walked around in the light and then asked, 'Where is this place?' I then saw father and grandfather running to my room from the living room to rescue me after hearing me screaming. Meanwhile, my body hit on the wooden door causing the lamp to disconnect from my hand and fall to the ground. I came back into my trembling body that couldn't stop shaking. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1987 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes My soul in the air saw my departed body screaming underneath. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness as normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When the electricity floated through my body. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was surrounded by the white light. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. as usual Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes. The light was brighter than the sunlight but I could watch it directly with my eyes. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was surrounded by white light. What emotions did you feel during the experience? peaceful, quiet Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I believe we can go on living after death. What is your religion now? Other faiths- Unitarian and other liberal faiths Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. When this thing happened, I was a normal child without religious ideas. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I believe we have a soul and can live after death. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I become more sensitive and fragile. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I turned out to be a more sensitive person. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Uncertain My soul above feel extremely peaceful while my body underneath screameds below. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. 31years have passed and I still remember this experience as if it happened yesterday. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? My soul left my body and I felt peaceful and without pain. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes 20 years later, I shared my NDE with a friend. He seems like he didn't believe it and was not interested to hear it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. It really happens. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. They are definitely real. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes one night, I felt a male ghost evaded my body. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? no Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? no

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Electrocution from turning off a table lamp with wet hands.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with viewing the physical scene (father and grandfather running in) while surrounded by bright white light; no tunnel, no beings, no boundary; then return when the lamp disconnected and fell.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Observed events in the room (father and grandfather running in; body convulsing) while also being encompassed by the bright white light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Later in life, reported: "one night, I felt a male ghost evaded my body."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Where is this place?”; “The light was brighter than the sunlight but I could watch it directly with my eyes.”; “My soul left my body and I felt peaceful and without pain.”
